sequence.action: Exhaust public manufacturer-controlled sources and current authorized-distributor lifecycle data.
Compare fully documented replacements and reject any option that degrades an accepted function or creates a larger uncontrolled risk.
Request missing controlled drawings or written mating data from the manufacturer without placing an order.
Only if the preceding routes fail, prepare a smallest-possible evidence-sample proposal for separate user approval.

official_findings.finding: QDtech publishes the donor schematic, display specification package and a board STEP file. The STEP assembly contains the controller PCB and its components, not the LCD/CTP flex body.
The schematic controls the HMX035CTFT-001 assembly marking and 40-contact electrical map, but is not a standalone panel ordering or mechanical drawing.

subjects.remaining_gap: No public manufacturer-controlled standalone order code, complete flex outline, contact-side/stiffener drawing or lifecycle statement was found.

replacement_review.reason: It is orderable and dimensioned but uses 4-wire SPI, is 61.00x92.44 mm and therefore does not preserve the accepted direct-QSPI occupancy contract.
It has an excellent controlled drawing and lifecycle surface, but uses RGB/4-line SPI, a 50-contact tail, a 59.56x93.34x5.66-mm body and a 13.5-17 V backlight.
It preserves QSPI through AXS15231B, but the raw LCD/CTP assembly still lacks a separately controlled order identity and flex drawing, reproducing the same procurement gap.

official_findings.finding: The current Ebyte specification fixes the 12x19-mm module, nRF24L01+ function, IPX external interface and recommends Ebyte's 2.4-GHz IPX antenna family.
The official Altium PcbLib contains the PE01-ML01IPX footprint and controlled connector-end axis.
Ebyte identifies its mating 2.4-GHz antenna interface as IPX/IPEX generation 1.
TE 2118651-2 is an active 30-mm UMCC Gen1-to-Gen1 assembly with full drawing and CAD data.
TE cross-references UMCC Gen1/MHF1 to Hirose U.FL-R-SMT-1(10); authorized-distributor stock exists for 2118651-2.

subjects.remaining_gap: Ebyte does not print the receptacle manufacturer's exact MPN in the module manual; current-lot identity remains an incoming-inspection item.

replacement_review.candidate: 3x bare Nordic NRF24L01P-R7 with local RF matching
replacement_review.reason: The chip and reference layout are fully controlled and currently orderable, but Nordic marks the family not recommended for new designs; direct RF integration also creates three new matching/layout qualifications.

replacement_review.candidate: Ebyte E01-ML01DP5 or E01-2G4M27D with SMA-K
replacement_review.reason: The larger high-power PA/LNA modules change current, RF output, coexistence risk and the accepted compact three-radio layout.

subjects.selected: M5Stack U214 with Samtec SSW-107-02-S-D host socket

official_findings.finding: M5Stack controls the U214 84x24x15.2-mm product envelope, 14-contact Cap-Bus map, mating products and current application.
The model-size drawing controls the 84-mm width, 24-mm depth, 15.287-mm maximum thickness and 56-mm retention pitch.
The official schematic identifies P1 as a 14-position 2.54-mm SMD header and controls every contact.
The reference host exposes an EXT 2.54-14P bus with the matching electrical pin map.

subjects.remaining_gap: Neither public schematic names the fitted male/female connector MPN or guarantees male-post section, exposed length, bottoming and repeated-cycle insertion with the selected Samtec socket.

replacement_review.candidate: generic alternative LoRa module or E22 carrier
replacement_review.reason: It loses direct compatibility with the accepted U214/Cardputer Cap ecosystem and does not remove the need for a controlled removable mechanical interface.
A different receptacle cannot prove the undocumented U214 post geometry; the Samtec part already has a controlled body, contact range and broad availability.
